span.p:
Redis Cluster
restart, sab replica pe
-> key khaali to sirf EK request lock le ke DB se banaye
baaki 50-100 ms ruk ke Redis se padhein
(lock: SET NX EX 5)
lock wala hi mara -> lock khud hate (TTL)
100 ms baad bhi khaali -> 2-3 retry, phir replica se
